summary: GMEX Robotics filed a Form 6-K on June 11, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the launch of a tool-free vision sensor mounting system for industrial robots. The filing describes a new product feature aimed at reducing downtime and improving factory efficiency, with no mention of any special-situation event such as mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, capital changes, or management shakeups. The registrant is the issuer of the press release but plays no transactional role. This is a routine product announcement, not a corporate event triggering special-situations classification.
